status: Proposed rubric; requires comparison against human labels before RL use.

identity.criteria: Blue tiger character; blond hair; yellow eyes; blue stripes; pink abdominal star where visible. Compare reference, do not punish naturally occluded markings.

cel_style.criteria: Clean lineart, flat color regions, sharp cel shadows; avoid penalizing a pose solely for its viewpoint.

hand_count.criteria: Count all five fingers on each hand required visible by the task. Count thumb explicitly. Report left/right or image coordinates and count independently. Overlap/occlusion must be unassessable, never presumed correct.

finger_shape.criteria: Long slender fingers with separate coherent contours; natural bending is allowed. Fused digits or disconnected digits fail.

foot_count.criteria: Count four toes on each sole required visible by the task. State each count and distinguish claws from toe boundaries. Occluded toes are unassessable.

yellow_pads.criteria: Visible palm and/or sole pads are yellow/gold, including digital pads; shading may change brightness. Do not invent pads on dorsal surfaces.

human_pose.criteria: Natural human-like leg structure and plantigrade stance when grounded. Sitting, kneeling and reclining may bend knees naturally; do not require every task to stand upright.

visibility_gate: Assess each required appendage separately. Missing/obscured required appendages reduce task-compliance/visibility score; hidden anatomy is not assigned a correct count. Non-required hidden appendages do not reduce anatomy score.
scoring: For active task.scoring_targets, score assessable items 0..1 with evidence; normalize their fixed weights across assessable active items. If a required anatomy target has no assessable appendage, its effective score is 0 for the task reward while the count judgment remains unassessable. Multiply by required-visibility compliance 0..1. Never reward identity_control tasks for unrequested pad/count targets.

appendages.evidence: five separated digit contours including thumb

calibration: Have the user label at least 50 baseline images including occlusion, fused digits, wrong colors and correct anatomy. Measure count accuracy, false-positive correctness and human preference agreement. Do not treat VLM confidence as calibrated probability. Hold out eval prompts from all reward/adapter tuning.
